fingerprint.chemistry: thiol/selenol-dependent peroxide reduction: a low-pKa peroxidatic cysteine (Cys-SH) or selenocysteine (Sec-SeH) attacks the peroxide O-O bond, is oxidized to a sulfenic/selenenic acid, and is recycled by a resolving Cys / thioredoxin / glutathione (NO heme or transition-metal cofactor)

fingerprint.name: Peroxiredoxin / thiol-based peroxidase

purpose: Record adding the peroxiredoxin_thiol_peroxidase mechanism-fingerprint family (50th fingerprint) and sourcing its first reviewed-Swiss-Prot bronze tranche, growing combined labels 8906 -> 9056 (+150) while leaving the frozen current702 benchmark byte-unchanged. Splitting the broad oxidoreductase EC 1.11.1 pool by mechanism (thiol/selenol vs heme) was the high-supply strategy the recon called for: this single lane filled its cap, vs 4 novel rows for the narrow metallo_beta_lactamase family.
representation_loop_note: In the leakage-safe feature space (cofactor classes + reaction bond-change, EC/name/prose/lane EXCLUDED) the cofactor-free Cys/Sec peroxidatic-thiol peroxide reduction reads like a cofactor-free Ser/Cys hydrolysis (alcohol + H2O product), so the dense 150-row peroxiredoxin centroid absorbs the already fold-blurred ser_his_acid_hydrolase rows: ser_his_acid_hydrolase self-consistency collapses 0.6 -> 0.0 (58 of its rows resolve to peroxiredoxin, 23 to alpha/beta-hydrolase). peroxiredoxin itself is coherent (0.833) and does NOT collapse its EC sibling heme_peroxidase_oxidase (heme vs no-cofactor separates them: 0.889). Overall LOO 0.716 -> 0.709 (above the 0.70 floor; floor NOT lowered); nonmetal fraction 0.758. This is the honest cost of a large confusable cofactor-free family; the disambiguation engine separates them at ADMISSION via family-text + peroxide reaction + EC-1.11.1 scope, but the source-free representation must not synthesize fold/name evidence.
reviewed_supply_note: 457 reviewed-Swiss-Prot thiol/selenol peroxidases (peroxiredoxins / glutathione peroxidases / thiol peroxidases) are reachable via the family-name handle, none previously imported (heme_peroxidase_oxidase requires a heme cofactor and these are non-heme). The first lane fetched 331, corroborated 304, and filled the 150 cap exactly.
